title: Final Answers
description: Essential Criteria: The student provides correct final answers for each reaction and decay process, identifying the conservation laws violated.

title: Conservation Laws
description: Important Criteria: The student correctly identifies the relevant conservation laws (baryon number, strangeness, isospin) for each reaction and decay.

title: Reasoning Steps
description: Important Criteria: The student explains the reasoning behind the violation of conservation laws for each reaction and decay process.

title: Specific Violations
description: Optional Criteria: The student specifies the exact values of changes in quantum numbers (e.g., Delta S, Delta I) where applicable.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student makes common errors such as misidentifying conserved quantities or incorrectly applying conservation laws.
